workspace:prismattyc.description: Prismattyc is a desktop terminal with session management, saved Spaces, and the pmux command line.

crate:pmux-mcp.description: MCP stdio adapter over the pmux Mail* socket

app:pmux-mcp:pmux-mcp.description: Exposes pmux session and mail actions through MCP over stdio.

module:pmux-mcp:pmux-mcp::mail.description: One Mail* round-trip on the pmux control socket. Each MCP tool call is one connection: RegisterClient, MailHello, one mailbox op, drop. Identity is the process `--as` / env agent; `MailSend` has no `from` field.

module:pmux-mcp:pmux-mcp::supervisor.description: Transparent stdio supervisor for MCP hosts that do not respawn a failed server process. MCP stdio is a stateful JSON-RPC session. Merely starting a fresh child after EOF is insufficient: the replacement must see the original `initialize` request and `notifications/initialized` notification before it may serve tools.

crate:prismattyc.description: Command-line entry point for running the Prismattyc terminal renderer.

app:prismattyc:prismattyc.description: Runs the terminal renderer inside an existing terminal.

module:prismattyc:prismattyc::splash.description: Launch splash screen (Kiro-style): ASCII art, version, a rotating tip, and a single-key menu. Shown only on a bare interactive `prism` launch (no explicit PROGRAM, stdin/stdout are TTYs); `--no-splash` or `PRISMATTYC_NO_SPLASH=1` opts out. Runs in the host terminal before the PTY is spawned, so it never touches the child or the mux.

crate:prismattyc-core.description: Shared classic-terminal screen model used by the renderer and host.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root.description: Shared classic-terminal screen model for Prismattyc.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::cell_.description: Keep rows contiguous while moving row identities instead of screenfuls of cells.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::clust.description: Screen-local storage for trailing grapheme scalars.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::damag.description: Per-frame grid damage for the host paint path (PT-242). Cell dirty and row dirty track writes. Scroll events are recorded separately so a consumer can blit without walking the grid.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::histo.description: Retained-row allocation accounting. Shared cluster storage is separate.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::reflo.description: Repack primary logical lines; the alternate screen remains a cell grid.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::test_.description: Wall-clock scale for test duration budgets (PT-254).

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::versi.description: Package version and the source revision captured at build time.

module:prismattyc-core:crate root::splas.description: Shared launch-splash content for the `prismattyc` CLI (ANSI, host terminal) and `prismattyc-host` (rasterized, in-window). One source so the art, tips, and brand palette cannot drift between the two front-ends.

crate:prismattyc-emulator.description: Parses terminal escape sequences and integrates terminal screens with child processes.

module:prismattyc-emulator:crate root.description: Classic VT parsing and PTY integration for Prismattyc. Rich document models stay out of this crate. A dependency-light [`prismattyc_protocol::ApcCollector`] sidecar recovers APC bodies because VTE 0.15 swallows APC without delivering the payload to [`vte::Perform`].

module:prismattyc-emulator:crate root::g.description: Retains Kitty graphics images and placements for each terminal screen. It validates image sizes, tracks cell anchors, and applies upload commands.
Minimal RFC 4648 base64 decoder for Kitty graphics payloads. Hand-rolled to avoid a new dependency (matches the no-dep-CLI style).
Bounded PNG decode. Rejects on IHDR dimensions and a byte cap BEFORE allocating pixel buffers (decompression-bomb defense), then normalizes to 8-bit RGBA.
Safe, bounded read of a child-supplied file (Kitty `t=f`). Opens the path, then validates the OPEN fd (no re-lookup) to defeat TOCTOU.
Kitty unicode-placeholder cells (`U+10EEEE` + diacritics). Ghostty `graphics_unicode.zig` is the layout reference.

module:prismattyc-emulator:crate root::s.description: Complete a split UTF-8 scalar without allowing parser lookahead to consume following characters. Ordinary buffers still use VTE's bulk advance path.

crate:prismattyc-host.description: Windowed OS host for Prismattyc — own window, not nested in Kitty/Ghostty

app:prismattyc-host:prismattyc-host.description: Opens the windowed Prismattyc terminal application.

module:prismattyc-host:prismattyc-host::.description: AccessKit chrome tree for `prismattyc-host` (PT-173 / PT-174 / PT-175, accessibility). Tree shape is a pure function of [`ChromeSnapshot`]. Window, mux, and AccessKit side effects stay in the caller.

Adopt nested TTY attaches (PT-210). `pmux new NAME` or `pmux attach` typed into a host pane runs a `pmux-attach` child under that pane's shell. The host never spawned it, so the pane carried no attach mark: the tab cache omitted it, `pmux space save` recorded no tabs, and `space open` fanned the sessions out one tab per session.

Log-backed attach pane (PT-111). The windowed host used to attach a pmuxd session by spawning `pmux attach --session-id ID` as a PTY child and running a second emulator over the ANSI that child painted. This module replaces that child with two control-plane connections: * a **reader** connection parked in `SubscribePane`, which turns the per-pane event log into [`LogMessage`]s for [`crate::mux::PaneRuntime`]; * a **writer** connection that sends key bytes with `WritePane` under the controller lease (acquired on the first key, released after [`LEASE_IDLE`]) and pushes host geometry to the server with `Resize`.
Attach-tabs cache helpers. Contract: `docs/mux-cli.md` (Where things live).
Retain only pixels covered by a transient border, including its head.

Optional user config file with hot reload. `$PRISMATTYC_CONFIG`, else `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/prismattyc/config.toml`, else `~/.config/prismattyc/config.toml`. CLI flags and `PRISMATTYC_*` env vars always win over the file, at startup and across reloads.
Full commented `config.toml` template (PT-84). [`CONFIG_KEYS`] is the source of truth for names, docs, ranges, and defaults. The generator, `--help`, and the field-coverage test read it.

Pixel-space damage retained by presentation backends. The compositor passes the returned [`FrameDamage`] to the PT-244 aged buffer repair layer. The layer unions this frame with every newer frame that the selected wl_shm slot missed (including age 2 and age 3 slots) before copying pixels.
Background Git labels for pane working directories.
Feature-gated wgpu present of the existing CPU `u32` framebuffer. Glyphs stay on the CPU. This module only uploads the softbuffer-shaped buffer and draws a nearest-neighbor fullscreen triangle.

Resolve explicit OSC 8 hyperlinks and auto-detected HTTP(S) runs. OSC 8 wins when a cell carries an explicit target. Unsafe explicit targets remain non-clickable and never fall through to displayed-text detection.
App icon for the windowed host (brand assets under `assets/brand/`).

User keybindings for host actions (keybindings, PT-41). One table maps named [`Action`]s to [`Chord`]s. Dispatch, the chord strip, `--help`, and `docs/config.md` all read this table, so a rebinding shows up everywhere.

Keyboard encoding for the windowed host (legacy xterm subset). winit delivers keys as [`Key::Named`], [`Key::Character`], and optional `text` / physical [`KeyCode`]. Terminal hosts must handle **all three** — Space was dropped because it arrives as `NamedKey::Space`, not `" "`. This module encodes host key events using the active Kitty or xterm keyboard mode reported by the focused child.

Window-local Space views containing explicit blank terminals. Keep the complete runtime so PTYs, split ratios, tabs, and focus survive a switch. Stable Space IDs distinguish a rename from a replacement Space.
Alpha-capable presentation above the AppKit blur backdrop. Keep straight ARGB pixels between frames. Only damaged tiles are copied, premultiplied, and published as immutable Core Graphics images.

macOS menu integration (menu bar and Dock menu). winit 0.30 owns the `NSApplicationDelegate`. To surface a Dock right-click "New Window", we add `applicationDockMenu:` to winit's delegate class at runtime (Task 4 spiked delegate reachability; Task 7 promotes it to a real injection wired to the same action target as the File menu, Task 5).
Small AppKit integration for window properties that winit does not expose.
Freeze the visible terminal's identity, including nested attaches, before a move.
Multi-pane runtime binding for the windowed host.
Serializable local-shell layout recipes. No command or process state is saved.

Desktop notifications for the windowed host (PT-39). Spawn-and-forget over the platform CLI: `notify-send` on Linux/BSD, `osascript` on macOS. Every failure — missing binary, no notification daemon, no session bus — is swallowed, so a bell can never take the host down.

Pure command-palette state and keyboard behavior (PT-92, direction C): a query row, filter chips, a RECENT section, a MATCHES section, and a detail box for the selected row. No pixels here; `raster.rs` paints the [`PaletteView`] this module builds.
A static, pane-owned visual bell with one cleanup deadline.
Pixel conversion shared by presentation backends and native probes.
Bounded image updates for the retained macOS compositor layers.
A fixed side rail width. Pointer dragging changes geometry immediately.
Software cell-grid rasterizer for the windowed host.
Apply an attach-tabs file to a live host (PT-65, PT-213). Sessions already attached move (identity preserved). Sessions in the file but not attached get a new pane via `pmux attach`.

Background SSH catalog requests for remote Spaces (issue #24). Contract: `docs/design/remote-spaces-ssh.md`. One bounded, non-PTY `ssh … pmux space catalog` runs per explicit connect or refresh; nothing polls a disconnected destination.

Remote destinations in the Space rail (issue #24, option B). One chip per configured `[[remote]]` destination follows the local chips. Selecting a chip connects (or refreshes) that destination and opens its Space list.
Complete render guard diagnostics. The legacy reason keeps its priority order.
Cooperative host restart. Blank/local PTYs require the old process to stay.
Search existing terminals across Space views. Navigation never starts a session.
One startup decision before the registered host consumes its saved cache.
Per-pane experimental rich session. Windowed host rich peer: frozen 0.1/0.2 overlays plus the bounded 0.3 reserved-workspace/tree slice. Grant-after-flush is unchanged.
One name creates or renames a session and its mailbox.
Serialize host requests across the CLI child and the host cache apply.
Phase 1 open feedback. Session facts come from bounded daemon snapshots.
Optional team details in the existing keyboard-accessible Space menu.

Spaces rail (PT-91): the saved spaces (`spaces/*.json`) as fixed-width chips on one edge of the window, the space counterpart of the tab strip. The rail is a view over the spaces directory. It never owns a Session: a chip opens a space through `pmux space open`, renames the file, or deletes it after a confirm.
Project daemon ownership into a window and the live pane-name rail.
Space preferences, visible save state, and guarded undo of membership edits.

In-window launch splash for bare `prismattyc-host` launches — the same content as the `prismattyc` CLI splash (shared via `prismattyc_core::splash`), rasterized into the window instead of printed to a terminal. Shown on the first window only; `--no-splash`, `PRISMATTYC_NO_SPLASH=1`, and config `splash = false` opt out. Attach launches skip it (attaching drops you into live sessions, the same way an explicit PROGRAM skips the CLI splash).

System font discovery for glyphs the bundled faces omit. Ghostty reference (`src/font/discovery.zig`): - Linux: fontconfig charset match (`FcFontMatch` + `FC_CHARSET`) - macOS: Core Text cascade / `CTFontCreateForString` for Han - Never return LastResort tofu - Do not bundle CJK or color-emoji; use whatever the OS has Prismattyc keeps a short well-known path list (fast, no FFI) and on Linux asks fontconfig for any other installed script.

Named host themes: terminal defaults + ANSI 0-15 + Prismattyc chrome tokens. Built-ins are embedded from reviewable TOML files. A config may also name a file in the sibling `themes/` directory or use an absolute file path.
Title-row label and unfocused-pane notice (PT-190). Pure decisions. Window, mux, and paint side effects stay in the caller.

Walkthrough session, caption band, and host detectors (PT-192–196). Catalog, progress, and `detect_step` live in `prismattyc_mux::walkthrough`. This module keeps `WalkthroughLive`, caption geometry, and hit testing.
Bundled walkthrough narration (PT-197). Clips are generated offline by `scripts/walkthrough-voice.sh`. Runtime never calls ElevenLabs.

Native Wayland `wl_shm` present with per-pixel alpha (PT-118). softbuffer 0.4 hardcodes `wl_shm` `Xrgb8888`, so its Wayland path drops the alpha byte. This module presents `Argb8888` buffers on the winit window's own `wl_surface` through a guest handle on the same connection. ARGB8888 is one of the two `wl_shm` formats every compositor must accept, so the path is portable by specification rather than by probing. winit clears the opaque region on `with_transparent(true)` windows (`reload_transparency_hint`), so an ARGB buffer alone gives real show-through; no EGL/Vulkan driver path is involved.
Straight-alpha canonical framebuffer and bounded shm buffer-age repair.

cargo-feature:prismattyc-host:default.description: Enables the default compile-time feature set declared for the windowed host.

crate:prismattyc-labs.description: Browser labs POC: in-memory agent mail + splash attract (wasm32)

module:prismattyc-labs:crate root.description: Prismattyc browser labs (PT-106 POC). Pure client WASM: in-memory agent mail + splash `art_frame` from core. No PTYs, sockets, or pmuxd.

module:prismattyc-labs:crate root::agent.description: Agent identity validation for the browser lab. Ported from `prismattyc-mux::mailbox::agent_id` so the lab rejects exactly what `pmuxd` rejects, with the same error text. Keep the rules and the messages in sync with that module.

module:prismattyc-labs:crate root::mailb.description: In-memory agent mailbox for the browser lab. Mirrors the `prismattyc-mux` mailbox lifecycle (open → held → commit/release) without SQLite or Unix sockets — pure client WASM per PT-106. The contract this file must keep true (see `prismattyc-mux/src/mailbox/store.rs`): - letters are keyed by recipient agent id, never by session; - **open** letters wait to be claimed; **held** letters are claimed but uncommitted; - `claim` returns every uncommitted letter (open become held, already-held are re-listed — the reconnect recovery path); - `commit` deletes held letters **by id**; `release` returns held letters **by id** to open; ids this agent does not currently hold are ignored, not an error; - `depth` reports both tiers, `(open, held)`.

module:prismattyc-labs:crate root::wasm_.description: `wasm_bindgen` browser surface (wasm32 only). The mail verbs mirror the `pmuxd` control plane: a connection is bound to one agent identity, and every verb acts on that identity only. `mailSend` derives `from` from the binding — there is no way to forge a sender — and claim/commit/release/peek take no agent argument, because the daemon's `Mail*` requests take none either.

crate:prismattyc-mux.description: Owns pmux sessions, windows, panes, layouts, and the background session server.

app:prismattyc-mux:pmux.description: Manages Prismattyc sessions from a terminal or script.

module:prismattyc-mux:pmux::lifecycle.description: User-facing restart coordinator. Live PTY owners are deferred by default.

module:prismattyc-mux:pmux::pane_write.description: CLI for the intentional pane-write protocol.

module:prismattyc-mux:pmux::skills.description: Install the embedded pmux Agent Skill into user-level agent directories.

module:prismattyc-mux:pmux::space_comman.description: Exclusive Space operations. The daemon owns live membership; the store serializes definitions and retains an interrupted transaction for recovery.

app:prismattyc-mux:pmux-attach.description: Connects an existing terminal to a pmux session.

module:prismattyc-mux:pmux-attach::windo.description: Console byte input and socket wakeups share native wait handles.

app:prismattyc-mux:pmuxd.description: Keeps pmux sessions running in the background.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root.description: Session, window, pane, and layout management for Prismattyc (Phase 2 / 2A). Architecture: `docs/architecture.md`; mux domain contract: mux architecture. This crate owns mux topology and the optional long-lived server runtime.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::attach.description: Live, window-local identity for a nested terminal attach. No daemon restart required.
Scan live `pmux-attach` clients. Used by `pmux doctor` / `kick` / `ls` to tell a host-side viewer from a nested attach inside a pane child tree. No control-plane verbs.

Host attach-tabs cache: `{stem}.attach-tabs.json` beside the mux socket. Contract: [docs/mux-cli.md](../../../docs/mux-cli.md) (Where things live). `save` writes a temp file in the same directory and renames it.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::attent.description: Hive ↔ Prismattyc mail loop (ADR-0039). Forward: `cells.list` + `attention.peek` → join pane by `bound_pid` → `MailAttentionSet` (Hive `queue_rev`) → `InjectMail` → `inject.report`. Reverse: when peek is drained, clear `pane.mail` so attach/host drop the letter.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::compon.description: Cooperative component restart requests. A component handles its own state; the coordinator never signals an arbitrary PID or replays guest input.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::config.description: Shared `[mux]` table in the Prismattyc config file. Same path as `prismattyc-host`: `$PRISMATTYC_CONFIG`, else `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/prismattyc/config.toml`, else `~/.config/prismattyc/config.toml`. CLI flags and `PMUX_*` env vars always win over the file.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::contro.description: Versioned local control plane for Prismattyc's in-process mux (PRD §2.8.7). The wire format is one bounded JSON object per line. Each connection owns a monotonically increasing request-id space.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::domain.description: Domain root: sessions → windows → pane layout → panes. **Server topology only** (PRD §2.8.3): focus and active-tab selection are per-client view state ([`ClientView`]), not stored on [`Window`]/[`Session`].

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::host_r.description: Registered windowed host next to the mux socket (PT-65). The host writes `{stem}.host.pid` at start and removes it on exit. Alive means `kill(pid, 0)` succeeds.
Read-only snapshots of the registered host's render guards.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::ids.description: Opaque stable typed IDs. Never reused for the lifetime of a [`crate::Domain`].

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::image_.description: Clipboard image → temp PNG → child paste text. Agent CLIs cannot consume `image/png` on a PTY. paste is text-only; an image-only clipboard currently fails `get_text` (windowed host) or arrives as an empty bracketed paste (mux-attach). Cursor then shows `[image omitted]`.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::inject.description: Per-CLI submit bytes for `InjectMail`. The doorbell text is the fixed token `PMUX_MAIL`. The terminator depends on the guest TUI (live probes, 2026-08-15): - Grok: one CR submits (Enter).

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::layout.description: Binary pane layout tree (geometry algorithms land in).
Saved mux layouts and multi-session spaces: snapshot → JSON file → split plan. Files do not store pane ids. Single-session layouts store spawn-time cwd.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::mailbo.description: Durable agent mailbox inside pmuxd. SQLite store, Mail* dispatch, and in-process doorbell.
Defines stable agent IDs for pmux mailboxes and validates their accepted form.

Persist session-name → agent_id across pmuxd restarts. Live uniqueness is enforced in [`crate::Domain`]. This file is the durable map so a later recreate of the same session name can be rebound by the operator with `--agent`.
SQLite mailbox store for pmuxd (agent-keyed since). Letter send/claim/commit/release/broadcast. Mail must survive pmuxd restarts.

Mailbox arrival notification for `MailWait` (dispatch lands in). One condvar for the whole daemon. The predicate is evaluated under the watch lock and [`MailboxWatch::ring`] takes the same lock before notifying, so a ring can never slip between a waiter's predicate check and its park — the lost-wakeup window is closed by construction.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::pane_l.description: Per-pane event log (PT-76) and SubscribePane catch-up (PT-77). Sequence numbers are monotonic and never reused. The ring is bounded by payload bytes (default 4 MiB), not event count.
Persist pane-log snapshot + tail next to `mail.db` (PT-115). The file is instance-keyed (`pane-log-<instance>.json`). Restore matches session name and pane index, not pane slot order.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::procin.description: Portable process inspection for mux/host. Linux uses `/proc`. macOS uses `sysctl` / libproc. Other unix: `kill(0)` only.
Portable process inspection for mux/host. Linux uses `/proc`. macOS uses `sysctl` / libproc. Other unix: `kill(0)` only.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::releas.description: Immutable GitHub releases, verified downloads, and atomic version activation. No git checkout or relationship to the pre-0.2 repository is required.
Immutable GitHub releases, verified downloads, and atomic version activation. No git checkout or relationship to the pre-0.2 repository is required.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::remote.description: Remote Space catalog schema and SSH destination identities (issue #24). Contract: `docs/design/remote-spaces-ssh.md`. The remote CLI builds a [`Catalog`] from saved Space files joined with a live daemon snapshot; the host parses it with [`parse_catalog`].
Pane-size arbitration for shared attach (PT-200). The most recently active client sets the pane size (tmux `window-size latest`). `--fit` always wins.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::rich.description: Server-side experimental rich sidecar. Flag-gated APC session on each live pane. Grant-after-flush.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::sessio.description: Human-readable session names shared by the CLI and host naming popup.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::space_.description: Shared Space details for the desktop, CLI, and MCP.
Reusable definitions. Preview has no daemon or process side effects.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::superv.description: Hive supervisor client for Prismattyc mux-server (ADR-0037 lane B–C). One long-lived intent: act as an **operator-privileged** Hive control client and emit `supervisor.cell_exited` on pane liveness edges. The send path is **best-effort and non-blocking from the mux's point of view** — notices are enqueued with `try_send`; a full or disconnected queue drops + logs rather than stalling PTY drain or the control loop.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::team_a.description: Explicit requests for human input. Mail delivery remains independent.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::uninst.description: `pmux uninstall` / `prismattyc uninstall` — one shared command that removes everything Prismattyc installed or wrote on this machine. Mirrors the shared [`crate::update`] command: both front-door binaries call [`run_uninstall`], which resolves the same base directories used by the installer and the self-updater ([`crate::platform`]) and never touches a path outside the product's own inventory. # Behaviour - Print exactly what will be removed, then confirm (unless `--yes`). - After confirmation, stop the daemon and sessions cleanly, warning first. - Default removes everything, including Spaces and config data. - `--keep-data` keeps Spaces and config. - `--dry-run` lists the inventory and removes nothing. - Anything that cannot be removed is reported with what, why and the fix; the rest is still removed. - Exit non-zero if anything is left; end by confirming it is fully gone or naming the leftovers. Path safety: only paths in the computed inventory are ever removed.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::update.description: Checkout `main`, pull, and `cargo install` host / mux / pmux-mcp / prismattyc binaries.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::walkth.description: Shared walkthrough catalog, progress, and detectors (PT-192–198). Pure parse, validation, XDG progress load/save, `detect_step`, and the boss snapshot matcher. Host caption geometry and `WalkthroughLive` stay in `prismattyc-host`.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::local_.description: Native filesystem-addressed local sockets on Unix and Windows.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::path_s.description: Installs and removes the app-bundled `pmux` PATH link on macOS.

module:prismattyc-mux:crate root::platfo.description: OS operations shared by the daemon, clients and host.

crate:prismattyc-protocol.description: Defines bounded control and graphics protocol types shared across Prismattyc components.

module:prismattyc-protocol:crate root.description: Dependency-light Prismattyc control protocol types and bounded wire codecs. Streaming APC **body** collection lives here so the classic emulator can hand off complete bodies without depending on a rich document model.

module:prismattyc-protocol:crate root::s.description: Logical semantic documents, ranges, and decoration-free projection.

module:prismattyc-protocol:crate root::g.description: Sidecar collector for Kitty graphics APC sequences: `ESC _ G <ctrl>;<payload> ESC \`. VTE swallows APC without delivering it to `Perform`, so we scan the raw byte stream in parallel (same technique as `ApcCollector`, but scoped to the `G` graphics namespace, with a much larger body cap for base64 pixels).

module:prismattyc-render:crate root.description: Classic cell-grid rendering and future swappable backends for Prismattyc.

module:prismattyc-rich-client:crate root.description: Public app-side client for Prismattyc rich wire 0.1/0.2 plus the bounded 0.3 reserved-workspace slice. This crate owns negotiation, raw-TTY lifecycle, local generation/revision tracking, event validation, detach, workspace snapshots, and classic fallback. It depends only on `prismattyc-protocol`.

features.label: Desktop terminal
features.description: The windowed host renders terminal panes, keeps keyboard and theme settings, and organizes sessions in Spaces.

features.label: Session control
features.description: The mux owns sessions, windows, panes, layout, and the local control protocol. The pmux tools manage sessions from scripts and terminals.

features.label: Agent mail
features.description: pmux stores local agent messages in the session server. The MCP adapter exposes mailbox actions to MCP clients.

features.label: Remote Spaces
features.description: The host requests remote Space catalogs over SSH and shows remote destinations in its Space rail.

features.label: Terminal graphics
features.description: The emulator decodes and retains Kitty graphics payloads. The host has an optional GPU presentation path.

features.label: Rich sessions
features.description: The host and mux contain experimental rich-session code, with a separate public client crate for the wire protocol.

features.label: Browser lab
features.description: The WebAssembly lab is a proof of concept with in-memory agent mail and a browser surface.
